*Pack Light, CarryOn*. Old turns are fol"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"ded into small, versioned records of
what the agent has established ("carriers") and an execution co"},{"id":"p5s4","text":"ntext: the task, open obligations and the next step.
Each fold is validated before it is committed, "},{"id":"p5s5","text":"and a rejected fold changes nothing."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/5f4a6889-5cf6-41a4-aff1-327a9d5d6b7b"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"CarryOn demo by the paper's authors. Also on the project page."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"The CarryOn runtime, from the paper. - **Validated folds.** A fold that fails validation leaves the session un"},{"id":"p11s5","text":"touched. Rescans then back off as in the
paper. Close to the context limit, a failed fold falls back"},{"id":"p11s6","text":" to dsh's own summary, so the session can go on.
- **Resumable.** Fold state is stored as readable J"},{"id":"p11s7","text":"SON in the session log and restored on resume.
- **Ported, not reinvented.** The runtime is a TypeSc"},{"id":"p11s8","text":"ript port of carrycode,
